python -c "
import semver
# Verify all public names
for name in ['replace', 'createparser', 'main', 'process']:
    assert name in dir(semver), f'{name} not in dir(semver)'
    assert hasattr(semver, name), f'{name} not an attribute'
print('All public names accessible')

# Verify replace function
v = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
assert v == '2.2.3', f'Expected 2.2.3 got {v}'
v = semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=4, patch=5)
assert v == '1.4.5', f'Expected 1.4.5 got {v}'
v = semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha.1', prerelease='beta.2')
assert v == '1.2.3-beta.2', f'Expected 1.2.3-beta.2 got {v}'
v = semver.replace('1.2.3+build.1', build='build.2')
assert v == '1.2.3+build.2', f'Expected 1.2.3+build.2 got {v}'
print('replace function works')

# Verify VersionInfo.replace
vi = semver.parse('1.2.3-alpha.1+build.1')
vi2 = vi.replace(major=2)
assert str(vi2) == '2.2.3-alpha.1+build.1', f'Got {vi2}'
assert str(vi) == '1.2.3-alpha.1+build.1', 'Original mutated!'
vi3 = vi.replace(minor=4, patch=5, prerelease='beta.2', build='build.2')
assert str(vi3) == '1.4.5-beta.2+build.2', f'Got {vi3}'
print('VersionInfo.replace works')

# Verify immutability
vi = semper.parse('1.2.3')
# oops typo
" 2>&1 | head -5
